strongest_angle: Investigating leaked documents detailing how Deloitte Cyprus and Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate papers and used fake timestamps to help billionaire Roman Abramovich hide $10bn in assets and vanish superyachts, mansions, and private jets worth $672m from company accounts.

key_facts.fact: Accounts signed off by Deloitte in Cyprus meant assets such as superyachts, mansions and private jets worth $672m vanished from Roman Abramovich's company accounts.
Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate papers on behalf of billionaire Roman Abramovich.
Deloitte staff used fake timestamps to rewrite the historical record before acting as independent auditor to sign off accounts helping Roman Abramovich hide $10bn in assets.

A trove of emails shows that Deloitte Cyprus helped firms beneficially owned by Roman Abramovich retroactively transfer assets to the British Virgin Islands in an apparent bid to skirt tax and disclosure obligations.
